name: Rocq
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec.vcl -t Rocq -o Rocq.v

name: RocqVerify
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec.vcl -t Rocq -o Rocq.v && rocq compile -w none -vok Rocq.v

name: Isabelle
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec.vcl -t Isabelle -o isabelle/Isabelle.thy

name: IsabelleVerify
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec.vcl -t Isabelle -o isabelle/Isabelle.thy && isabelle build -d vehicle-isabelle/ -d isabelle/ IsabelleTestRank2 > /dev/null 2>&1
